get.summary: Read a cached DexScreener Solana rank snapshot

post.summary: Refresh one CLAWD DexScreener Solana rank
post.description: Trusted terminal/server route. Requires x-terminal-secret or a valid backrooms bearer key, then calls CLAWD with process.env.CLAWD_API_KEY. Never expose this route as an unauthenticated browser action.

post.summary: Refresh all CLAWD DexScreener Solana ranks
post.description: Trusted terminal/server route. Requires x-terminal-secret or a valid Backrooms/admin bearer key, then calls CLAWD Firecrawl refresh-all with server-side CLAWD_API_KEY.
